text:
maya: Quick sync — subject-line playbook + inbound routing for next week's launch newsletter. Need A/B, segment-specific variants, and immediate routing of 'hot' leads to SDRs. Who can own what?

jenn: I can own subject lines + SendGrid templates. Propose 3 headline directions to test:
- Variant A: Redwood Inference — ship LLM features with predictable latency
- Variant B: Cut per-token cost on prod LLMs (see benchmarks)
- Variant C: Meet SLAs for LLM inference — launch checklist inside ✅
Also want to test emoji vs no-emoji.

akshat: I'll own segmentation and the audience queries. Proposing these segments: Active trials (7d), High-usage API customers (last 30d > 100k tokens), Dormant accounts (no activity 30–90d). Sample SQL for Active trials:
```sql
SELECT user_id, email FROM users WHERE trial_started_at >= now() - interval '7 days' AND email_opt_in = true;
```
I'll output lists as CSVs to campaign-config.

zach: Routing notes — hot lead rule: open_rate > 40% AND clicked_demo_link within 72h -> push to SDR queue A (high-touch). Else fallback to nurture flow with staged drips. How are we naming the click event?

jenn: Click event is `email_clicked_demo_v2` (tracked in events table). We already have webhook that maps that to CRM 'Activity: Demo Click'.

maya: Can we run subject-line A/B on 20% sample per segment, hold 80% for winner rollout? Metric: demo_click_rate and MQL conversions after 7 days. Also ensure UTM params: utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=launch_v1&utm_medium=email. @akshat can you add UTM tagging into the segment export?

akshat: Yes — will append utm fields in CSV and push a PR to `campaign-config` with filenames `launch_v1_segment_*`. ETA EOD. Link to config repo: https://git.internal/redwood/campaign-config (private).

zach: I'll wire up routing in the automation layer. Pseudocode for rule I'll deploy:
```yaml
rules:
  - name: hot_lead_to_sdr
    when: event == 'email_clicked_demo_v2' and user.open_rate >= 0.4 and event.time <= 72h
    action: push_to_queue('sdr-high-touch')
    notify: '#sales-leads'
```
I'll also add a Slack alert with user email + segment + snippet of last activity.

jenn: For templates: I'll create `launch_v1_A`, `_B`, `_C` in SendGrid, plus variants emoji/no-emoji. Avoid pricing language on first touch; highlight latency, predictable cost, and rollout checklist. Sample subject lines I'm testing:
- "Ship LLM features with predictable latency — Redwood Inference"
- "Reduce inference cost per token — real benchmarks inside"
- "Want predictable LLM SLAs? See our launch checklist"

maya: Great. Action items summary: Jenn — templates + variants + sendgrid setup (A/B config). Akshat — segments, CSVs, UTM fields, PR to `campaign-config`. Zach — routing rules, Slack notifications, SDR queue mapping. I'll collect initial lift metrics and do a quick review Thu AM.

campaign-bot: Scheduled send created for `launch_v1` cohort (preview send at 2024-05-02T15:00Z) :calendar:

maya: Thanks all — please drop quick confirmations when done. :white_check_mark:
